FlowDynamic.description: Vehicle flow count over a measurement period.

detectorId.description: Identifier of the detector this reading is about.
detectorId.title: ObjectId

quality.description: Optional quality statement for this measurement.

kind.description: Discriminator for the tagged union. The fixed value "flow" selects the FlowDynamic payload; it is not free-text command content.

totalFlow.description: Total vehicle count over the period. Omitted when only class counts are reported.

periodSeconds.description: Duration of the measurement period in seconds.

classCounts.description: Per-class vehicle counts in positional order — index 0 is Class1, index 7 is Class8. May be shorter if trailing classes are absent. A null entry means that class was not reported, as distinct from a count of zero.

extensions.description: Vendor or local extensions. Open-content object.
